verdict.rationale: Pulley is a SaaS equity-management platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no public API, no API versioning and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the llms.txt probe shows only a help-center index, which is not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
